question: Sri Lanka is separated from India by the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Palk strait.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sri Lanka **is separated from India by the **Palk Strait, **a narrow strait that lies between the southeastern coast of India and the northernmost tip of Sri Lanka.
 
• The Palk Strait is approximately **53-80 kilometers** wide and about** 400 kilometers long.**
 
• The Palk Strait is named after **Robert Palk,** a British governor of Madras Presidency during the late **18th century.**
 
• The Palk Strait is an important shipping lane that connects the **Bay of Bengal and the Arabian Sea.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Isthmus of Kra **is a narrow strip of land in Thailand that connects the** Malay Peninsula with mainland Asia.**
 
• The** Strait of Gibraltar** is a narrow strait that connects the **Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea.**
 
• The **Isthmus of Panama** is a narrow strip of land that connects** North and South America.**
